name: Video Essay
summary: A voice reads an argument over film clips, stills, quotes and maps. Clean type, a steady grid, slow zooms and a muted grade give the frame the calm of a printed essay.

philosophy.core_thesis: Treat the frame as a page of an essay: one claim, one piece of evidence, and a quiet layout that lets the argument lead.
design_principles: Show one piece of evidence in each shot and hold it for 4s to 10s.
Set the clip in a frame at 80% to 90% of the width with a 24px black margin.
Put a quote or a title in a serif face at 36px to 48px, flush-left, for at least 4s.
Add a source line at 14px in the lower-left corner for each clip: title, year and maker.
Apply a slow zoom of 3% to 6% over the shot, as in the Ken Burns effect.
Use a muted grade with a charcoal ground (#14161A) and one warm accent (#E0A458).
Place numbered chapter cards of 2s between sections: a number in 96px and a title in 36px.
anti_patterns: Hard sound hits at each cut
Decorative frames that compete with the clip

layout.grid_mechanics: A 16:9 frame on a 12-column grid with a 24px black margin; clips take 8 to 10 columns and text takes the rest.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25% to 40% of the frame is quiet ground; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24 and 48px.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush-left text on a fixed baseline; clips centre in the frame; source lines align to the lower-left margin.
layout.container_geometry: Straight 0px to 2px corners; thin 1px rules between sections; a chapter card with a large number.

font_pairings.note: A high-contrast serif for quotes with a neutral text face.
A calm serif pair that suits long reading.
An editorial pair with a mono option for source lines.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.01em; source lines take +0.06em in capitals.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights: regular (400) and bold (700).
Set chapter numbers in 96px at 40% opacity.

color.palette_structure: Charcoal and paper with one warm amber accent and one cool grey.
color.contrast_rules: Paper text on charcoal holds at least 14:1; amber carries rules and chapter marks, not long text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat charcoal ground with a 3% film grain and a 10% vignette; clips keep their own grade.
color.light_and_shadow: No glow; a 1px line at 20% white separates the clip from the ground; a 12px soft shadow under cards.

materiality.surface_simulation: A dark screening room: archive clips, scanned stills and paper quotes on a flat ground.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px rule at 20% white between blocks; no border on clips.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur on text; the ground may blur at 20px behind a still; a 12px soft shadow at 30% black.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons at 20px with a 1.5px stroke for the source and the chapter; round terminals.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Film stills, archive photographs, maps, screenshots and quotes; one arrow or underline in amber when needed.

motion.transition_physics: Slow zooms of 3% to 6% over the full shot; cross-fades of 400ms; text appears with a 300ms fade and stays for at least 4s.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover underlines a link in amber; active state dims the text by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels guided by a thoughtful voice and trusts the argument.

avoid_when: The viewer needs a fast, loud hook.
The content has no argument or evidence.
The format is a short vertical clip.

modifiers.how: Add a facecam window at 20% width, outlined captions and sound hits.
Move to a paper ground with large serif headings and a column grid.
Cut each claim to 8 seconds and show it as 4-word captions with one highlighted word.

pack.why: A thin outline family stays out of the way of quotes and clips.

ground.why: The ground is a dark page with thin rules, like the margin of a printed essay.
